title: Hall of Mirrors
description:
Hall of mirrors is a game for up to five players, a game that plays with the real physics of light and reflection. Fire your laser at a balloon to score points. Use the mirrors to reflect your ray to reach more targets – and the more it reflects, the better you score. You might also hit each other!

There can be up to four laser players, using shared keyboard and/or game controllers.  Then there’s the Thief, a good role for younger players. He simply moves around with the arrow keys grabbing balloon. But oh, he does make a tempting target!

A rich options screen allows many combinations of board size, player set, and control configuration.  Play a simple board - or craft your own, insanely large and complex.

Get the whole family around the coffee table with this game, shouting at each other with excitement!
description_short: Five people on one computer, really? Yes, this fast-action arcade-style multiplayer game is for the whole family! Shoot balloons with your lasers to score points – but the beams will often bounce off mirrors, creating interesting and complex shots. The more complex, the greater the score!
